skills.name: Apparatus Positioning (Fend-Off Angle)
skills.description: Position apparatus at a 45-degree angle pointing away from the work zone to create a physical traffic barrier.

skills.name: Cone Taper & Buffer Zone Deployment
skills.description: Deploy sequential traffic cones to establish an active merge taper and a protected lane buffer.

skills.name: High-Visibility PPE & Warning Devices
skills.description: Don high-visibility safety vests, helmets, and deploy emergency warning triangles or flares.

skills.name: Roof Ladder Placement & Securing
skills.description: Hoist, position, and securely hook a roof ladder to structural ridge or approved anchor points.

skills.name: Sounding Structural Integrity
skills.description: Systematically sound the roof surface using a tool handle ahead of movement to check for stability.

skills.name: Rectangular Ventilation Cut Sequence
skills.description: Execute proper louver or rectangular cut sequence coordinated with interior fire attack teams.

skills.name: Inward-Swinging Door Forcing (The Irons)
skills.description: Properly gap, set, and force an inward-swinging door using a flat-head axe and Halligan bar.

skills.name: Outward-Swinging Door & Padlock Control
skills.description: Expose hinge pins or use specialized striking techniques to defeat outward-swinging and padlock assemblies.

skills.name: Forward and Reverse Lay Operations
skills.description: Establish efficient water supply lines from a municipal hydrant to the attack pumper.

skills.name: Drafting Operations from Static Source
skills.description: Connect hard suction hose, strainers, and prime pump to draft water from a static source.
